text-brand-1 text-[16px] font-[300] leading-[28.8px] [&amp;&gt;strong]:font-[500] [&amp;&gt;b]:font-[500] [&amp;&gt;a]:text-col-brand-00 [&amp;&gt;a]:no-underline [&amp;&gt;a:hover]:underline"><h2 style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; margin: 32px 0 16px 0;">MiniMax Speech 2.8: Breathing Life into AI Voice</h2>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">Today, we are excited to introduce MiniMax Speech 2.8.</p>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">This isn't just a technical upgrade; it's a breakthrough in vocal authenticity. By introducing native sound tag support, high-fidelity cloning, and studio-grade clarity, we are closing the gap between AI and the human voice.</p>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">Our mission remains clear: to make synthetic speech feel truly human and indistinguishable.</p>

<h2 style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; margin: 32px 0 16px 0;">1. Reclaiming the "Nuance": Teaching AI to Hesitate and Breathe</h2>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">In the past, AI voices often felt cold because they were "too perfect". Real human speech is filled with imperfect breaths, pauses, and hesitations—subtle signals that convey emotion and emphasize key points.</p>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">Speech 2.8 introduces Native Sound Tags. By modeling colloquial fillers like "um," "uh," and "ah," we preserve the natural rhythm, pitch, and pauses of human dialogue.</p>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">No more robotic, flattened speech; the warmth is in the details.</p>
</div><div class="w-full px-[20px] lg:px-0 lg:w-[768px] my-[32px]"><div class="w-full h-[113px] p-[24px] flex items-center justify-between bg-col-bg-01 rounded-[12px]"><div class="w-[40px] h-[40px] rounded-full bg-brand-1 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" class="animate-spin"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" stroke="white" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="45 15"></circle></svg></div><div class="relative flex-1 h-full ml-[20px]"><div class="text-[14px] text-brand-1 font-[500] leading-[19px]">Speech-2.8 Sound Tags Demo</div><div class="mt-[17px] w-full h-[4px] rounded-[4px] bg-col-fill-01"><div class="h-full bg-brand-1 rounded-[4px] relative" style="width:0%"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="15" height="14" viewBox="0 0 15 14" fill="none" class="absolute -top-[5px] -right-[12px]"><circle cx="7.5" cy="7" r="6" fill="currentColor" class="text-brand-1" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.75"></circle></svg></div></div><div class="text-[14px] text-col-text-02 leading-normal absolute right-0 top-[11.5px]">00:00<!-- --> / <!-- -->00:00</div></div></div></div><div class="w-full px-[20px] lg:px-0 lg:w-[768px] m-0 p-0 text-brand-1 text-[16px] font-[300] leading-[28.8px] [&amp;&gt;strong]:font-[500] [&amp;&gt;b]:font-[500] [&amp;&gt;a]:text-col-brand-00 [&amp;&gt;a]:no-underline [&amp;&gt;a:hover]:underline"><blockquote style="margin: 8px 0; padding: 8px 10px; border-left: 3px solid #ddd; background: #f9f9f9; color: #555; font-size: 14px;">
<p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0;">Text: "Hey, it's me. How are ya? (chuckle) I hope you're having an awesome day! We actually had a bit of a crazy launch day yesterday, you know, but (breath) I'm just recovered and ready to roll. You're listening to this and probably thinking I'm just chatting into a microphone, right? But here's the twist: (clear-throat) I'm actually not human. I am the new Speech 2.8 model from MiniMax. Crazy, right? (laughs) If you listen closely, you can hear how I handle the pacing, the little breaths, and even that casual vibe. Have a great day!"</p>
</blockquote>

<h2 style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; margin: 32px 0 16px 0;">2. Voice Cloning: Replicate Your "Vocal Fingerprint" in 10 Seconds</h2>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">We have optimized our feature extraction process to achieve a new level of similarity in voice cloning. With just a 10-second sample, Speech 2.8 precisely captures your unique texture, breathiness, and even your specific speaking pace.</p>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">The result isn't just a voice that sounds "like" you—it <span style="font-style: italic;">is</span> you.</p>

<blockquote style="margin: 8px 0; padding: 8px 10px; border-left: 3px solid #ddd; background: #f9f9f9; color: #555; font-size: 14px;">
<p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">Authentic Conversationality</span>: The voice has a "lived-in" quality. It doesn't sound like a stiff announcer; instead, it sounds like a trusted friend sharing a story over coffee.</p>
<p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">Dynamic Cadence</span>: This speaker uses natural fillers and rhythmic pauses (like "but anyways," "you know") that create a sense of spontaneity and presence.</p>
<p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">Warm, Mid-Range Resonance</span>: The timbre is grounded and steady, providing a sense of comfort and reliability that builds immediate rapport with the listener.</p>
</blockquote>

<h2 style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; margin: 32px 0 16px 0;">3. Pure Audio: Eliminating Background Noise and Digital Artifacts</h2>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">Audio purity is the foundation of a premium experience.</p>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">We've re-engineered our processing engine to eliminate background noise and synthetic distortion. The result is a crystal-clear, transparent output that delivers the presence of a professional narrator recording in a studio.</p>
</div><div class="w-full px-[20px] lg:px-0 lg:w-[768px] my-[32px]"><div class="w-full h-[113px] p-[24px] flex items-center justify-between bg-col-bg-01 rounded-[12px]"><div class="w-[40px] h-[40px] rounded-full bg-brand-1 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" class="animate-spin"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" stroke="white" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="45 15"></circle></svg></div><div class="relative flex-1 h-full ml-[20px]"><div class="text-[14px] text-brand-1 font-[500] leading-[19px]">Speech-2.8 Noiseless Demo</div><div class="mt-[17px] w-full h-[4px] rounded-[4px] bg-col-fill-01"><div class="h-full bg-brand-1 rounded-[4px] relative" style="width:0%"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="15" height="14" viewBox="0 0 15 14" fill="none" class="absolute -top-[5px] -right-[12px]"><circle cx="7.5" cy="7" r="6" fill="currentColor" class="text-brand-1" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.75"></circle></svg></div></div><div class="text-[14px] text-col-text-02 leading-normal absolute right-0 top-[11.5px]">00:00<!-- --> / <!-- -->00:00</div></div></div></div><div class="w-full px-[20px] lg:px-0 lg:w-[768px] m-0 p-0 text-brand-1 text-[16px] font-[300] leading-[28.8px] [&amp;&gt;strong]:font-[500] [&amp;&gt;b]:font-[500] [&amp;&gt;a]:text-col-brand-00 [&amp;&gt;a]:no-underline [&amp;&gt;a:hover]:underline"><blockquote style="margin: 8px 0; padding: 8px 10px; border-left: 3px solid #ddd; background: #f9f9f9; color: #555; font-size: 14px;">
<p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0;">Deep in the forest, there lies a silence that remains untouched. As the first light of dawn filters through the dense canopy, the world seems to hold its breath. Listen closely—that is the soft whisper of the wind through the pines, a sound so delicate it is barely more than a secret.</p>
<p style="margin: 0 0 8px 0;">Let us linger in this peace for a moment, rediscovering the essential gentleness that the noisy world so often hides.</p>
</blockquote>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">Smarter Cross-Lingual Performance: A Global Voice for Every Market</span></p>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">We're breaking down language barriers by eliminating the "accent bleed" that often occurs in AI speech.</p>

<p style="margin: 0 0 12px 0; text-align: justify;">Starting with our Mandarin-Japanese pair, we've fixed unnatural tones and pronunciation shifts to ensure every voice sounds like a true native speaker. Stay tuned as we bring this seamless experience to even more languages soon.</p>
